scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.db:remote:dry-run: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db push --linked --dry-run
scripts.db:remote:reset: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db reset --linked --yes
scripts.db:remote:list: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase migration list --linked
scripts.db:remote:test: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase test db --linked
scripts.db:remote:test:sql: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db query --linked --file supabase/audit/phase_0_pgtap_linked.sql
scripts.db:remote:lint: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db lint --linked --level warning --fail-on error
scripts.db:remote:advisors: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db advisors --linked --type all --level info --fail-on error
scripts.db:remote:security: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db query --linked --file supabase/audit/phase_0_security.sql
scripts.db:remote:fingerprint: npm run db:remote:assert && supabase db query --linked --file supabase/audit/phase_0_fingerprint.sql
